rootCause: REV 1.0.94 reused ordinal test requirement IDs after test-selection changes. A locked booking for the former test could therefore have the same stepId as a different new test; because the planner validated resources but not task semantics, it could preserve the stale booking as if it represented the new test. Sticky planning rendered bookings while process/test setup rendered current testRequirements, so the two views diverged.
